sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a strong upright stride, the hammer trailing low behind him in his near hand, the bare far arm swinging, the LEGS STEPPING IN TURN, the cape and the hair swaying
sheets.weapons: THE HAMMER goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): held in his NEAR hand (the gauntleted one), hanging head DOWN by his feet unless the pale figure swings, raises or thrusts it - then its head goes where the pale figure's does. Only ONE hammer, the design's (two curved silver-white blades with a violet-blue gem between them). His FAR arm stays BARE in every frame.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: the NEAR foot (the lighter leg) planted on the ground AHEAD of his hips (right); the FAR leg (the darker one) kicked up BEHIND him (left), its foot off the ground. Frame 2: PASSING: the near foot planted right under his hips; the far leg comes through in front of it, its knee lifted, its foot off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: the near (lighter) foot is on the ground in frames 1-3 and 8, the far (darker) foot in frames 4-7. Follow the pale figure's LEGS exactly - every frame has one foot off the ground; never the same leg pose in every frame.
